text: Which entity types, fields and links actually matter — to emerge from running P01 discovery through the OS, not designed up front.
Whether `claude -p` (print mode) or the Claude Agent SDK behaves better on Windows for streaming and session continuity.
resolution: `claude -p --output-format json` with --session-id/--resume works on Windows (native claude.exe); ~3-12 s per turn without streaming. Agent SDK not needed for v0.1.
